description: This file is a JUnit test class for the UserController in a Spring Boot application, testing various user-related functionalities such as fetching user info, updating email/password, and registration, with mocks for dependencies.

classes.name: UserControllerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for UserController, testing user retrieval, email checks, updates, and registration with mocked services.

methods.name: getUser_returnsUser_ifPresent
methods.description: Tests that getUser returns a User object when the user exists.

methods.name: getUser_returnsNotFound_ifUserIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that getUser throws ResponseStatusException when the user is not found.

methods.name: emailExists_returnsOk_ifTrue
methods.description: Tests that emailExists returns OK if email is registered.

methods.name: emailExists_returnsNotFound_ifFalse
methods.description: Tests that emailExists returns Not Found if email is not registered.

methods.name: updateEmail_returns404_ifUserNotFound
methods.description: Tests updateEmail response when current user is not found.

methods.name: updateEmail_returns401_ifPasswordIncorrect
methods.description: Tests updateEmail response when the provided password is incorrect.

methods.name: updateEmail_returns400_ifNewEmailSameAsCurrent
methods.description: Tests updateEmail response when new email is the same as current.

methods.name: updatePassword_returns401_ifExistingPasswordNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests updatePassword response when current password is incorrect.

methods.name: updatePassword_returnsBadRequest_ifPasswordIsNotVeryStrong
methods.description: Parameterized test for various weak passwords triggering PasswordTooWeakException.

methods.name: register_throwsBadRequest_whenEmailTaken
methods.description: Tests registration when email is already registered.

methods.name: register__should_check_if_email_service_is_called
methods.description: Verifies that email service method is invoked during registration.
